A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] served as a '''[[Medic/Legends|medic]]''' to the [[Outbound Flight]] [[Survivors (Outbound Flight)|Survivors]]. In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]], she treated [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]]'s injuries and conducted tests on his [[Blood/Legends|blood]] in order to synthesize plasma.<ref name="SQ" />
